name: @sengac/fspec
description: Feature Specification & Project Management for AI Agents - Manage Gherkin specs and work units with ACDD workflow

scripts.build:rust:fspec: (cd rust && cargo build -p codelet-fspec --release) && mkdir -p dist && cp rust/target/release/fspec dist/fspec && chmod +x dist/fspec
scripts.bridge:telegram:bg: nohup npx tsx bridge/telegram-endpoint.ts > bridge/telegram.log 2>&1 & echo $! > bridge/telegram.pid && echo 'Telegram bridge started in background (PID saved to bridge/telegram.pid)'
scripts.bridge:telegram:stop: kill $(cat bridge/telegram.pid) 2>/dev/null && rm bridge/telegram.pid && echo 'Telegram bridge stopped' || echo 'No running bridge found'
scripts.bridge:relay:bg: nohup npx tsx bridge/relay-endpoint.ts > bridge/relay.log 2>&1 & echo $! > bridge/relay.pid && echo 'Relay bridge started in background (PID saved to bridge/relay.pid)'
scripts.bridge:relay:stop: kill $(cat bridge/relay.pid) 2>/dev/null && rm bridge/relay.pid && echo 'Relay bridge stopped' || echo 'No running bridge found'
scripts.bridge:server:bg: nohup npx tsx bridge/relay-server-cli.ts > bridge/server.log 2>&1 & echo $! > bridge/server.pid && echo 'Relay server started in background (PID saved to bridge/server.pid)'
scripts.bridge:server:stop: kill $(cat bridge/server.pid) 2>/dev/null && rm bridge/server.pid && echo 'Relay server stopped' || echo 'No running bridge server found'

author: rquast@sengac.com
